description: Mined headings and notice clauses from official public hearing, ordinance, and election notices. Slots are filled only from recorded hearing actions, local measures, and election contests.

slots.date: The date recorded for the hearing or election.
slots.title: The filed measure's recorded short title.
slots.place: The jurisdiction recorded for the election.
slots.office: The election contest's recorded office title.
